label: Outweighed reason: better in one respect, worse overall, and not favoured
definition: Outweighed rk good φ s r x y: at scenario s, in respect r the candidate y is better than x (rk r s y x), yet overall x is better than y (good s x y) and the profile φ favours x over y. Respect-wise betterness rk and overall betterness good are parameters, read as value rankings; no aggregation of respects into the overall ranking is typed. Example: a plan better for one recipient and worse overall, passed over. Non-example: a respect in which the favoured candidate is also better.
